using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Garnet.common;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class ReplicaSyncSessionTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<ReplicaSyncSession>> _mockLogger;
        private readonly ReplicaSyncSession _session;

        public ReplicaSyncSessionTests()
        {
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicaSyncSession>>();
            _mockLogger.SetupAllProperties();

            // Create minimal session with logger injected (assuming protected setter or constructor access via testing pattern)
            _session = new ReplicaSyncSession();
            
            // Use reflection to set private logger field for testing
            typeof(ReplicaSyncSession).GetField("logger", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?
                .SetValue(_session, _mockLogger.Object);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task WaitForFlushAsync_WhenFlushTaskThrowsException_LogsErrorAndSetsFailedStatus()
        {
            // Arrange
            var exception = new InvalidOperationException("Test exception");
            var faultedTask = Task.FromException(exception);
            
            typeof(ReplicaSyncSession).GetField("flushTask", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)?
                .SetValue(_session, faultedTask);

            // Act
            await _session.WaitForFlushAsync();

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(m => m.ToString().Contains("WaitForFlushAsync")),
                    exception,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            // Verify status was set to FAILED
            Assert.Equal(SyncStatus.FAILED, _session.GetSyncStatusInfo.syncStatus);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task WaitForSyncCompletionAsync_WhenWaitThrowsException_LogsErrorAndSetsFailedStatus()
        {
            // Arrange
            var exception = new OperationCanceledException("Test cancellation");
            
            // Mock the signalCompletion to throw immediately
            var signalField = typeof(ReplicaSyncSession).GetField("signalCompletion", 
                System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            var mockSignal = new Mock<IWaitable>();
            mockSignal.Setup(x => x.WaitAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                .ThrowsAsync(exception);
            signalField?.SetValue(_session, mockSignal.Object);

            var tokenField = typeof(ReplicaSyncSession).GetField("token", 
                System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            tokenField?.SetValue(_session, CancellationToken.None);

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<OperationCanceledException>(() => _session.WaitForSyncCompletionAsync());
            Assert.Same(exception, ex);

            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyFormat<string>>(m => m.ToString().Contains("WaitForSyncCompletionAsync") && 
                                                 m.ToString().Contains("failed waiting for sync")),
                    exception,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyFormat<string>, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            // Verify status was set to FAILED
            Assert.Equal(SyncStatus.FAILED, _session.GetSyncStatusInfo.syncStatus);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void NeedToFullSync_WhenConditionsMet_ReturnsTrue()
        {
            // Arrange - setup conditions that should trigger full sync
            // This tests the logic path but focuses on the logging coverage from the other methods

            // Act
            var result = _session.NeedToFullSync();

            // Assert - basic smoke test
            Assert.IsType<bool>(result);
        }
    }
}

namespace Garnet.cluster.Tests
{
    public class ReplicaSyncSessionLoggerTests
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<ReplicaSyncSession>> _mockLogger;
        private readonly ReplicaSyncSession _session;
        private readonly FieldInfo _loggerField;
        private readonly FieldInfo _flushTaskField;
        private readonly FieldInfo _ssInfoField;
        private readonly FieldInfo _signalCompletionField;
        private readonly FieldInfo _tokenField;

        public ReplicaSyncSessionLoggerTests()
        {
            _mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<ReplicaSyncSession>>();
            _mockLogger.SetupAllProperties();

            _session = new ReplicaSyncSession();
            
            _loggerField = typeof(ReplicaSyncSession).GetField("logger", 
                BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
            _flushTaskField = typeof(ReplicaSyncSession).GetField("flushTask", 
                BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
            _ssInfoField = typeof(ReplicaSyncSession).GetField("ssInfo", 
                BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
            _signalCompletionField = typeof(ReplicaSyncSession).GetField("signalCompletion", 
                BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);
            _tokenField = typeof(ReplicaSyncSession).GetField("token", 
                BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance | BindingFlags.Public);

            // Initialize ssInfo if null
            if (_ssInfoField?.GetValue(_session) == null)
            {
                var ssInfo = new SyncStatusInfo { syncStatus = SyncStatus.INPROGRESS };
                _ssInfoField?.SetValue(_session, ssInfo);
            }

            // Set logger
            _loggerField?.SetValue(_session, _mockLogger.Object);
            
            // Set token
            _tokenField?.SetValue(_session, CancellationToken.None);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task WaitForFlushAsync_WhenFlushTaskThrows_LogsErrorWithCorrectMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var exception = new InvalidOperationException("Flush failed");
            var faultedTask = Task.FromException<bool>(exception);
            _flushTaskField!.SetValue(_session, faultedTask);

            // Act
            await _session.WaitForFlushAsync();

            // Assert
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("WaitForFlushAsync")),
                    exception,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task WaitForSyncCompletionAsync_WhenSignalThrows_LogsErrorWithCorrectMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var exception = new OperationCanceledException("Sync cancelled");
            var mockSignal = new Mock<IWaitable>();
            mockSignal.Setup(x => x.WaitAsync(It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                      .ThrowsAsync(exception);
            
            _signalCompletionField!.SetValue(_session, mockSignal.Object);

            // Act
            await Assert.ThrowsAsync<OperationCanceledException>(
                () => _session.WaitForSyncCompletionAsync());

            // Assert - logger call happens in catch block
            _mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("WaitForSyncCompletionAsync") && 
                                                 v.ToString()!.Contains("failed waiting for sync")),
                    exception,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
